summary.title: Lab02_Group9_SmartCampus
summary.description: A university web portal for students to submit assignments and view grades, teachers to upload marks, and admins to manage accounts. The system uses a payment gateway for fees and an email service for notifications. It is hosted on a web server in a DMZ, connecting to an internal application server, database, and file storage.

diagrams.title: SmartCampus Level 1 DFD

data.name: TB1: Internet / DMZ
data.description: Boundary between the external internet users (Students, Teachers, Admin) and the internal web server application.

data.name: TB2: Internal Network
data.description: Boundary protecting the internal application servers, processes, and databases from unauthorized external access.

data.name: TB3: Third-party Services
data.description: Boundary separating the university's internal network from external third-party services (Payment Gateway and Email Service).

data.name: Student
data.description: External user who logs in, uploads assignments, and views grades/fee status

data.name: Teacher
data.description: External user who logs in, uploads marks, and downloads submitted assignments.

data.name: Admin
data.description: Internal user who manages accounts, resets passwords, and generates reports.

data.name: Email Service
data.description: Third-party external service used to send system notifications to users.

data.name:
P1 
Authenticate 
User
data.description: Validates credentials. Students/Teachers use password; Admins use password + OTP.

threats.title: Brute-force attack on teacher login
threats.description: An attacker runs an automated tool against the login page to guess a teacher's password. The login allows unlimited attempts, allowing the attacker to take over the account and change student marks.
threats.mitigation: Lock the account after 5 failed attempts, add rate limiting, enforce 12-character passwords, and offer MFA for teachers.

data.name:
P2 
Submit 
Assignment
data.description: Handles student assignment uploads and routes the files to storage.

threats.title: Student alters assignment file after submission
threats.description: A student submits an assignment, then finds a way to overwrite the file in D3 directly before the teacher downloads it, replacing a poor submission with a better one.
threats.mitigation: Make D3 write-once for students, use cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) to verify file integrity upon download.

data.name:
P3 
Manage 
Grades
data.description: Allows teachers to upload marks and students to view their grades.

threats.title: Student alters grade ID in URL
threats.description: A student notices their student_id=101 in the browser address bar and changes it to student_id=102. The system lacks proper authorization checks, allowing the student to view another student's grades.
threats.mitigation: Implement strict server-side access control checks (ensure the logged-in user matches the requested ID) and use indirect object references.

threats.title: Result-day traffic floods portal
threats.description: On result day, 5,000 students try to access the portal at the exact same time. The web server is overwhelmed, crashes, and legitimate students cannot view their grades.
threats.mitigation: Implement rate limiting, use a load balancer with auto-scaling, and cache static results pages.

data.name:
P4 
Manage 
Accounts
data.description: Allows admins to create users, reset passwords, and manage roles.

threats.title: Admin account has default password
threats.description: The test server has a default admin account (admin/admin). If this configuration is copied to production, an attacker can easily guess the credentials.
threats.mitigation: Force a password change on first login and enforce a complex password policy.

data.name:
P5 
Process 
Fee 
Payment
data.description: Communicates with the Payment Gateway to verify fee transactions.

data.name: credentials
data.description: Login credentials (username and password) sent from the user to the authentication process.

data.name: credentials
data.description: Login credentials sent from the teacher to the authentication process.

data.name: credentials
data.description: Login credentials (with OTP) sent from the admin to the authentication process.

threats.title: Session token stolen on the network
threats.description: A student logs in on a public university Wi-Fi network without HTTPS. An attacker sniffs the network traffic, steals the session token, and hijacks the student's active session.
threats.mitigation: Enforce TLS (HTTPS) on all data flows, set secure and HttpOnly flags on cookies.

data.name: assignment
data.description: Assignment file uploaded by the student to be processed.

data.name: marks
data.description: Grade data uploaded by the teacher to be saved.

data.name: grade query
data.description: Student requesting to view their specific grades.

threats.title: SQL injection in grade search
threats.description: A student enters ' OR 1=1 -- into the grade query field. The application concatenates this directly into an SQL query, returning all grades in the database.
threats.mitigation: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) in P3 to separate data from code, and implement input validation.

data.name: manage users
data.description: Admin requests to create, modify, or delete user accounts.

data.name: reports
data.description: Generated result report sent back to the Admin.

data.name: payment request
data.description: Fee payment details sent to the external gateway for processing.

data.name: payment confirmation
data.description: Transaction success/failure response returned by the gateway.

threats.title: Fake payment confirmation sent
threats.description: The payment gateway sends fee confirmations to P5 without a cryptographic signature. An attacker intercepts the flow and sends a fake "success" response, allowing a student to bypass fee payment.
threats.mitigation: Require cryptographic signatures on all payment callbacks and verify the signature in P5 before updating the database.

data.name: send email
data.description: Notification data sent to the external email service.

data.name: log events
data.description: Transaction logs written to the audit log for accountability.

data.name: save file
data.description: Assignment file routed to physical file storage.

data.name: save user
data.description: New or updated user details written to the database.

data.name: read user
data.description: Authentication queries the database to verify credentials.

data.name: save grades
data.description: Student marks written to the Grades database.

data.name: read grades
data.description: Process queries the database to retrieve student marks.

data.name: read files
data.description: Process retrieves the stored file to be downloaded.

data.name:
P6 
Generate 
Reports
data.description: Compiles student data and results into reports for the Admin.

threats.title: Report generation crashes server
threats.description: An Admin requests a massive report for all students across all semesters. The query consumes all server memory, causing the portal to go offline for other users.
threats.mitigation: Run heavy report generation in a background queue, limit the date range for reports, and implement timeout limits.

data.name:
D1 
User Accounts DB
data.description: Stores user credentials, roles, and profile information.

threats.title: Unencrypted backup of user DB
threats.description: The database administrator takes a nightly backup of D1 and stores it on a shared network drive without encryption. An attacker gains access to the drive and steals all user credentials.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt database backups at rest, store them in a secure offline location, and restrict access.

data.name:
D2 
Grades DB
data.description: Stores student marks and exam results.

data.name:
D3 
Assignment File Storage
data.description: Stores uploaded student assignment files.

threats.title: Uploaded file contains malware
threats.description: A malicious student uploads a PDF assignment that contains a hidden executable virus. When the teacher downloads the file to grade it, the malware infects the teacher's computer.
threats.mitigation: Scan all uploaded files with antivirus software, restrict file types to PDF/DOCX, and disable macros.

data.name: D4 Audit Log
data.description: Stores system logs, failed logins, and transaction history.

threats.title: Marks changed without an audit trail
threats.description: A teacher changes a student's grade directly in the database but denies doing so. Because the system does not log database changes or timestamps, the university cannot prove who made the change.
threats.mitigation: Implement a write-only Audit Log (D4) that records all grade changes with the user ID, timestamp, and old/new values.

diagrams.description: Level 1 Data Flow Diagram for the SmartCampus Online Exam and Result Portal. Models external entities, processes (P1-P6), data stores (D1-D4), and three trust boundaries (TB1-TB3).
